name: – Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela – After § 12 – Am 30
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 12a. Calls for EUR 5 million in commitment appropriations for a pilot workers’ factory rescue and cooperative green-conversion facility, accessible through an open call to workers’ cooperatives and cooperative-led consortia seeking to take over enterprises threatened with closure or relocation; calls for grants covering takeover preparation and initial green-conversion investment, conditional on viable business plans, democratic worker control, preservation of quality employment and measurable environmental objectives, in cooperation with public development banks and local and regional authorities;
